sentences.en: My driver's license expires at the end of this month.
sentences.zh: 我的驾照这个月底就到期了。

sentences.en: Are you going to renew your lease when it expires?
sentences.zh: 你打算在租约到期时续签吗？

sentences.en: He tried to enter Algeria with an expired diplomatic passport.
sentences.zh: 他试图用过期的外交护照进入阿尔及利亚。

mnemonic: ex(出，离开）+pire（呼吸）→离开呼吸→断气
